# technitium_cluster (Data Source)

Reads the cluster state of the server. Clusters are set up in the web console; on a Secondary node most configuration is synced from the Primary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "technitium_cluster" "this" {}

output "unreachable_nodes" {
  value = [for n in data.technitium_cluster.this.nodes : n.name if n.state == "Unreachable"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cluster_domain` (String) Cluster domain; empty when not clustered.
- `config_refresh_interval` (Number) Seconds between config syncs on Secondary nodes.
- `config_retry_interval` (Number) Seconds between config sync retries.
- `heartbeat_refresh_interval` (Number) Seconds between node state refreshes.
- `heartbeat_retry_interval` (Number) Seconds between retries after a failed refresh.
- `initialized` (Boolean) Whether the server is part of a cluster.
- `node_type` (String) This node's role: `Primary` or `Secondary`; empty when not clustered.
- `nodes` (List of Object) Nodes: `id`, `name`, `url`, `ip_addresses`, `type`, `state` (`Self`, `Connected`, `Unreachable`, ...), `version`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `server_domain` (String) This server's name.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `ip_addresses` (List of String)
